name: Blueberries
description: Little blue berries that need very little fuss. A cool, dry home is the best place to start.

storage.label: Whole
storage.advice: Refrigerate in the crisper and wash only when you are ready to eat.
storage.caution: Remove crushed or spoiled berries before storing.

buying: Look for intact berries without wet, crushed patches.
freshness: Throw away moldy berries and inspect neighboring fruit. Mold may extend below the surface.
leftovers: Fold into oatmeal or muffin batter.
Add a handful to a smoothie.

freezing.instructions: Use sound berries. For a dry pack, spread on a tray, freeze, and transfer into a freezer container. Follow the linked fruit guide for preparation.
freezing.quality: Expect a softer texture when thawed.
